notes.title: Let's celebrate the grand opening of Time Raiders and give gifts!
notes.content:
Dear Warriors,

Welcome to Time Raiders Mobile! To celebrate the launch of the game, we are now holding the open-sever community event on steam! Take a look and get shiny rewards!

Event 1: Milestones
When the numbers of the Wish list reach 100, all players will get rewards Unrivaled Legend Bubble *1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176646/6fae6eabd3d4e101551044b5bd2470a714d2b9ba.png[/img]
When the numbers reaches 200, all players will get rewards Unrivaled Legend Frame *1 and Gold Diamond *2000
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176646/cf9e3e3e0ef9a940ee7319c4b4ad0e3e741f89aa.png[/img]
When the numbers reaches 300, all players will get rewards Bloodbeast *1 and Gold Tiger Symbol*1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176646/697b69077af8be5ef985f4024dea29f15fa486d4.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176646/d6593660da3083906b0a2434df705d75d5441e43.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176646/f3675e481b43e22cdeb02d4f09fb521e21cd4423.png[/img][/url]

Event 2: Share to win
Share this post to your steam page and let more warriors enjoy this game! If the share numbers reach 500, we will send rewards of [spoiler] Future Tech - Clothing [/spoiler] to all players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176646/f981d9419c07f3d8961faa895bfc2795dc5853fb.png[/img]
Participate in the event and claim the rewards soon!
